response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and domains, with strong leadership in mentoring and infrastructure. However, his background lacks direct experience with C++ (though he has some C experience) and large-scale distributed systems/cloud architecture, which are critical for this role. His leadership experience is also more in engineering practices than in technical leadership for cloud platforms.
strengths: Strong software engineering background with leadership in testing and development methodologies (TDD, CI/CD)
Proven track record in building and scaling distributed systems (e.g., micro-services at Dunnhumby)
Active contributor to open-source projects and community initiatives, demonstrating technical passion
concerns: No direct experience with C++ (minimum 8 years required) or cloud compute platforms
Limited explicit experience in technical leadership roles (e.g., cloud/DevOps mentoring)
Resume emphasizes breadth over depth in cloud architecture and compute technologies
